company.name: EvenUp
company.shortDescription: EvenUp is the leading proactive AI platform for personal injury firms, supporting the entire case lifecycle from intake through resolution.
company.description:
EvenUp is the leading proactive AI platform for personal injury law firms. Firms such as Lerner & Rowe, Malman Law, and J&Y Law use EvenUp's AI-native capabilities to orchestrate workflows across the full case lifecycle: intake, treatment tracking, medical record and bill retrieval, medical chronologies, damages valuation, demands, negotiations, discovery, and trial preparation. 

Built on the largest personal injury dataset and backed by in-house legal and medical experts, EvenUp helps firms take on more cases, move them faster, and resolve them at higher value without adding headcount.

EvenUp is used by 30% of the top 100 PI firms and applied across more than 10,000 cases a week representing over $14 billion in damages.
